title: Matt Mc Possible NDE 7894
content: I always knew I had something in store for me ever since I was young. I was petrified of death my whole childhood and something was always telling me I'm going to die young. I had been through a lot of emotional trauma throughout my life and I was tormented by the way I was attacked by people ever since middle school. It seems I was hated for being a good looking guy and the other boys would do anything to make me look bad. They would dare me to do the silliest things. As a nice boy looking for security, I would do anything. This ended up becoming a repeated habit by people throughout my life. Threatened by the fact I would always be better than them, I would be messed with so I wouldn't gain credibility. Anyway I had kept to myself since 21 yrs old and settled down with a fiancé who I have 2 children with. Years had passed. I was facing my 28th birthday in a few weeks, but I had a strong feeling I wasn't going to be alive for this birthday. I started to have trouble breathing and it felt like my lungs were slowly freezing or paralyzing. I started seeing spirits and could feel a presence in the house. I was comfortable with that fact. As the days went by, I found myself sitting on my mattress on the floor and I completely stopped breathing. My lungs finally froze. I passed into the vacuum of a black hole. Then, I'm was in a universal space and had a few balls of energy, that were entities, around me. I noticed a big wheel beside me . The wheel had an electric blue thread spinning a web going towards the earth. I had a strong sense this was somehow cleaning up bad energy. I found myself begging to return to my body and saying I wasn't ready to die. There was a light of heavenly nature giving me a sense it wanted me to go into the light almost asking me to 'come up here with us.' I refused and explained that I have two young children who would miss me. The next thing I know is I've gone back into my body but my head was still a black hole vacuum. I was terrified and it seemed to last ages until my mind awoke back in my body. I could not breathe. I jumped up and grabbed the door frame and made myself get a lung full of air, it felt like the first breath I had ever taken I was so relieved. Anyway over the next few hours I noticed an immense blissful light filling my body. It started to emanate from my hands, eyes and mouth. It felt absolutely incredible and I was fascinated. I went for a walk and enjoyed this incredible experience, everything around me was beautiful and extremely colorful. On my way back home, my mind seemed to freeze in that geographical location. I seemed to be walking but the world was moving under my feet like I was on an escalator. A birds-eye perception?? It was bazaar. I made it home and everything was happening with a déjà vu feeling. Words I was saying were repeated on the TV exactly at the same time I was saying them. Extreme coincidences were happening, one after the other. I have never felt so much bliss and I know I will never feel like that again. This experience lasted 6-7 days. Over the next few weeks, I noticed I had been blessed with one amazing experience and had somehow tapped into the universal energy. I had received an encyclopedia of knowledge in a very short time. I was gifted. There is no doubt in my mind that this was the biggest mystery ever and that I was one of those people with an extraordinary story to tell. I have been battling this for a very long time, it left me frozen and infatuated with what had happened. I was obsessed with the feeling I had when the light filled my body and beamed out my eyes, mouth and hands. I keep taking myself back to those moments because there will never be anything that can match how beautiful it was. I'm now tapping into my psychic abilities and learning how to control an extra sensory perception. I'm quite telepathic now and its been making me a little ill. My mind is in overdrive. I have so much more to explain about what occurs in these 6-7 days of spiritual awakening.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Passed into the vacuum of a black hole.

arrival.other_being_detail: A few 'balls of energy' described as entities around him; a 'light of heavenly nature' that seemed to invite him to 'come up here with us.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'universal space' with a big wheel beside him; the wheel had an electric blue thread spinning a web going towards the earth, sensed as 'cleaning up bad energy.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reported returning to his body while his head still felt like a 'black hole vacuum' until his mind 'awoke back in my body,' then he forced himself to inhale.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Stopped breathing after days of worsening breathing difficulty ('lungs were slowly freezing or paralyzing' and then 'completely stopped breathing').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Non-ordinary features included a 'big wheel' with an electric blue thread/web to Earth; post-return 6–7 days of intense bliss/light, heightened color, déjà vu, and repeated TV/word synchronicities.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Stopped breathing → 'black hole' vacuum → 'universal space' with entities/wheel → heavenly light inviting him to go into the light → he begged/refused and returned due to his children → prolonged post-return altered state (6–7 days).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Big wheel with an electric blue thread spinning a web toward Earth (sensed as cleaning bad energy); after return, 'immense blissful light' filling body and emanating from hands/eyes/mouth; 6–7 days of intense synchronicities/deja vu and unusual perception (world moving under feet like escalator; possible birds-eye perception).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I passed into the vacuum of a black hole.” “There was a light of heavenly nature giving me a sense it wanted me to go into the light almost asking me to 'come up here with us.'” “I had received an encyclopedia of knowledge in a very short time.”
